description: This file contains functions for translating PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) MAC layer data structures into FAPI (FAPI API for LTE) PDU (Protocol Data Unit) format, including specific format parameter filling functions for different PUCCH formats and a main conversion function.

methods.name: convert_sr_bits_to_unsigned
methods.description: Converts SR bits enumeration to an unsigned integer.

methods.name: fill_format0_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 0 specific parameters.

methods.name: fill_format1_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 1 specific parameters.

methods.name: fill_format2_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 2 specific parameters.

methods.name: fill_format3_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 3 specific parameters.

methods.name: get_pucch_format4_m0
methods.description: Determines cyclic shift index for PUCCH Format 4 based on occurrence index.

methods.name: fill_format4_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 4 specific parameters.

methods.name: fill_format_parameters
methods.description: Selects and fills the appropriate format parameters based on PUCCH format.

methods.name: convert_pucch_mac_to_fapi
methods.description: Main function to convert MAC PUCCH info into FAPI PDU format.
